Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap of what I heard: Acme Health wants to validate latency & integration behavior for two core flows (patient-note generation & batch-summary ingestion), confirm SSO/SCIM feasibility, and validate cost/throughput at a 100 reqs/min steady state.

Suggested next step: a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive where we cover:
- Minimal viable integration (API + SSO)
- Performance profile and sizing assumptions
- Security/compliance checklist and evidence owners
- Pilot timeline and success criteria

Can you loop in the security and procurement owners who should be on that call? Below are two tentative windows (your timezone):
- Option A: Thu Sep 17, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
- Option B: Fri Sep 18, 1:00–2:15 PM PT

If neither works, share 2–3 windows and we’ll lock it. I’ll also bring our platform engineer and a short preread packet.

Thanks,
Marcus
